Name: Smoking-Cigarettes
Author: K1riko87
Description:
[heading]中文介绍[/heading]
功能
[list]
[*]皮埃尔杂货店以 [b]600g[/b] 出售香烟。[/*]
[*]Joja 超市以 [b]500g[/b] 出售香烟。[/*]
[*]每包包含 [b]5 根香烟[/b]，烟包不可叠放。[/*]
[*]物品图标下方的五段进度条会显示剩余数量。[/*]
[*]每根香烟的视觉效果持续 [b]20 个现实秒[/b]。[/*]
[*]香烟会固定在人物嘴部，并跟随人物移动和转向。[/*]
[*]背对镜头时烟杆会被头部遮挡，烟雾从头顶上方升起。[/*]
[*]烟雾具有五种不同形态，会随机交替出现并垂直上升。[/*]
[*]联机时，其他玩家可以看到抽烟动作和烟雾效果。[/*]
[*]物品描述会实时显示剩余数量、下一根恢复的能量、生命损失、连续吸烟档位和重置时间。[/*]
[*]能量与生命变化会以游戏原有的数字效果显示。[/*]
[/list]连续吸烟的默认效果：
[table][tr][th]连续次数[/th]
[th]恢复能量[/th]
[th]损失生命[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]第 1 根[/td]
[td]30[/td]
[td]0[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]第 2 根[/td]
[td]25[/td]
[td]0[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]第 3 根[/td]
[td]15[/td]
[td]10[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]第 4 根[/td]
[td]8[/td]
[td]15[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]第 5 根及以后[/td]
[td]3[/td]
[td]20[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]距离上次吸烟达到 [b]180 个现实秒[/b] 后，下一根会重新按照第一档计算。进入新的一天也会重置连续吸烟次数。
香烟可以令玩家生命降至 0。因吸烟昏倒后，玩家会在哈维诊所醒来，并触发专属对白。
将香烟送给 NPC 时会消耗当前整包：
[list]
[*]塞巴斯蒂安最喜欢香烟。[/*]
[*]其他所有可收礼 NPC 最讨厌香烟。[/*]
[/list]使用方式
[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]解压 Mod，将得到的
[code]cigarettes[/code]文件夹放入游戏的
[code]Mods[/code]文件夹。[/*]
[*]中文版和英文版只能选择一个安装。[/*]
[*]进入游戏后，在皮埃尔杂货店或 Joja 超市购买烟包。[/*]
[*]将烟包放在快捷栏并选中。[/*]
[*]对空白位置按右键即可抽出一根香烟。[/*]
[*]门、商店、NPC、箱子等游戏原有的右键交互拥有更高优先级。[/*]
[*]一根香烟尚未结束时，不能连续使用下一根。[/*]
[*]按 [b]Alt+F10[/b] 打开设置菜单。[/*]
[*]开启“去掉抽烟负面效果”后，每根香烟固定恢复 30 点能量，不再递减或损失生命。[/*]
[/list]联机时建议房主和所有参与玩家安装相同版本。负面效果开关由房主控制。
[line]
[heading]English Introduction[/heading]
Features
[list]
[*]Cigarette packs are sold by Pierre for [b]600g[/b].[/*]
[*]JojaMart sells them for [b]500g[/b].[/*]
[*]Each pack contains [b]five cigarettes[/b] and cannot be stacked.[/*]
[*]A five-segment bar below the item icon displays the remaining amount.[/*]
[*]Each cigarette remains active for [b]20 real-time seconds[/b].[/*]
[*]The cigarette stays attached to the player’s mouth while moving or turning.[/*]
[*]When facing away from the camera, the cigarette is hidden behind the player’s head and the smoke appears above it.[/*]
[*]Smoke uses five distinct randomized patterns that alternate without immediately repeating and rise vertically.[/*]
[*]Smoking visuals are synchronized between players in multiplayer.[/*]
[*]The item description displays the remaining amount, next energy recovery, health loss, chain tier, and reset time.[/*]
[*]Energy and health changes use Stardew Valley’s original floating-number effects.[/*]
[/list]Default consecutive-smoking effects:
[table][tr][th]Consecutive use[/th]
[th]Energy restored[/th]
[th]Health lost[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]First cigarette[/td]
[td]30[/td]
[td]0[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Second cigarette[/td]
[td]25[/td]
[td]0[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Third cigarette[/td]
[td]15[/td]
[td]10[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Fourth cigarette[/td]
[td]8[/td]
[td]15[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Fifth and later[/td]
[td]3[/td]
[td]20[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]After [b]180 real-time seconds[/b] without smoking, the next cigarette returns to the first tier. The chain also resets at the beginning of a new day.
Smoking can reduce the player’s health to zero. A smoking-related collapse sends the player to Harvey’s clinic and triggers unique dialogue.
Giving cigarettes as a gift consumes the entire current pack:
[list]
[*]Sebastian loves cigarettes.[/*]
[*]Every other giftable NPC hates them.[/*]
[/list]How to Use
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod and place the resulting
[code]cigarettes[/code]folder inside the game’s
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Install either the Chinese or English edition, but not both.[/*]
[*]Purchase a pack from Pierre or JojaMart.[/*]
[*]Place the pack on the toolbar and select it.[/*]
[*]Right-click an empty location to smoke one cigarette.[/*]
[*]Vanilla interactions with doors, shops, NPCs, chests, and other targets take priority.[/*]
[*]Another cigarette cannot be used until the current 20-second effect has ended.[/*]
[*]Press [b]Alt+F10[/b] to open the settings menu.[/*]
[*]Enabling “Disable smoking penalties” makes every cigarette restore 30 energy without diminishing returns or health loss.[/*]
[/list]For multiplayer, the host and all participating players should install the same version. The host controls the negative-effect setting.
